resources.string: Keeps each app\'s own volume applied
Tap to open · use “Panel” for quick control
Shows a small round button on screen. In split screen or pop-up view (e.g. YouTube + TikTok) tap it to change each app\'s volume without leaving.
Turn on “Per-app volume control” to see apps that are playing audio.
Connect Shizuku first (see the card above).
No app is playing audio yet.\nOpen YouTube, TikTok… and play something – it will show up here.
All apps will go back to 100% and be unmuted.
Android doesn\'t let normal apps change other apps\' volume. Shizuku (free) grants the needed access without root or a computer. Tap “Guide” for the steps.
Open Shizuku and tap “Start” (via Wireless debugging). Repeat after each reboot.
Please update Shizuku to the latest version.
Tap “Grant” and choose “Allow all the time”.
This device doesn\'t let Shizuku read audio players. If your phone is rooted, try starting Shizuku with root.
Turn on the switch below to start controlling each app\'s volume.
Open several apps at once (split screen / pop-up view), then drag each app\'s slider or mute it below.
Connect Shizuku before turning this on.
Shizuku is off. Open Shizuku and tap “Start”.
To use the floating button in split screen, enable “Display over other apps” for App Volume Mixer on the next screen.

1. Install Shizuku from Google Play (“Get Shizuku” below).

2. Enable Developer options: Settings → About phone → tap “Build number” 7 times.

3. Connect to Wi-Fi, open Developer options → turn on “Wireless debugging”.

4. Open Shizuku → “Pairing” → follow the steps to enter the pairing code from Wireless debugging.

5. In Shizuku tap “Start”.

6. Come back to this app → “Grant” → “Allow all the time”.

How to use:
• Open YouTube and TikTok together (split screen or pop-up view).
• Drag each app's slider, or tap its speaker icon to mute only that app.
• Turn on “Floating quick button” to adjust while watching.
• The phone's volume keys still control the overall volume.

Note: after rebooting, open Shizuku and tap “Start” again (not needed on rooted phones).
